prompt: In the town where the most successful American Ace of World War 2 to survive that war was born, there is a college. What was the name and percentage of the largest demographic of full and part time students attending that college in 2020?
answer:
The town is **Bessemer, Alabama**, birthplace of **David McCampbell**, the highest-scoring American WWII ace to survive the war. The college there is **Lawson State Community College**.

In 2020, the largest demographic was **Black/African American students**—approximately **83% of full-time students** and **74% of part-time students**.
